title: The Holy Spirit Comes
reflectionQuestion: On that happy day, God's Spirit came to be with Jesus' friends always. What is something that fills you with joy?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, core-launch finale). The birthday of the church -- wind, gentle flames, every language, bold joy. FIRE here = PRESENCE / joy / the Spirit (soft, warm little flames resting on each friend) -- deliberately CONTRASTED with 1842 Carmel's fire = proof ('Yahweh is God'). Adam approved the same-batch fire pairing precisely because the meaning is opposite (proof vs presence); the prose keeps Pentecost fire gentle, never consuming. Character turn = Peter (once too afraid to admit he knew Jesus -> now bold with joy) -- a kid-readable fear->courage arc. Lands on the not-alone spine: God's Spirit comes to stay, 'never leave them alone' (feedback_kid_not_alone_thread). Church defined as a FAMILY, not a building (kid-concrete). 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_HANNAH_HOPE (bright, encouraging -- Acts uplift). One of 4 kid registers = JOY/wonder (feedback_kid_four_registers).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
